description: State Highway Network Lines is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. StateHighways are state highways based upon the Caltrans Linear Referencing System. Each record in this layer represents a highway segment where the county, route, postmile prefix, and postmile suffix are the same. Each segment has a begin and end postmile. This geometry is based upon the extraction from TSN on 8 June 2025. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Transportation, State Highways, Caltrans, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData, CalSTA, California State Transportation Agency. The bounding box given is -124.2649,32.5443,-114.2983,42.0055. The hub shows 2025-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (StateHighways is made available to the public solely for informational purposes.
